blocks.html: High-pressure-steam piping and high temperature hot water piping regulated by Section 1211 of the New York City Mechanical Code, shall be subject to special inspection in accordance with this section. Special inspection of seismic bracing shall be performed in accordance with Section 1705.12 of this code.
